result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: Customer receives a 30-day convenience-termination right and a refund of prepaid fees for the post-termination period, while Vendor has no such right during a term. However, “in whole or in part” creates an additional partial-termination right, and “without ... further liability” could unintentionally excuse accrued payment or other surviving obligations. Those additions exceed what is needed and risk altering unrelated commercial intent. The refund would also be clearer if expressly described as pro rata.
